title: GPT detectors are biased against non-native English writers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the false positive rates and text perplexity of seven off-the-shelf GPT detectors on human-authored writing samples from native English speakers (US 8th-grade essays) versus non-native English speakers (TOEFL essays). The study also involved using ChatGPT to modify the linguistic diversity of the writing samples to test its direct impact on misclassification rates.
